---
title: "Operations"
subtitle: "Trends, seller prioritization, and data quality summary"
---

```{r setup-skills, echo=FALSE}
source("R/website_helpers.R")
silent_run({
  source("R/trend_analysis.R")
  source("R/seller_prioritization.R")
  source("R/data_quality_audit.R")
  trend_res <- run_trend_analysis("data/processed/order_level_analysis.rds")
  seller_res <- run_seller_prioritization("data/processed/seller_order_analysis.rds")
  audit_res <- run_data_quality_audit()
})
issues <- audit_res$issue_summary
get_count <- function(name) {
  idx <- which(issues$issue_name == name)
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(0L)
  as.integer(issues$issue_count[idx[1]])
}
```

<div class="ops-section">

<div class="ops-section-header">
<div class="ops-icon"><i class="bi bi-graph-up-arrow"></i></div>
<h2>A. Monthly Trends</h2>
</div>

<div class="question-card">
<div class="card-title">Business Question</div>
How did monthly completed-order volume and total customer payment value change over time?
</div>

```{r trend-kpis, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(kpi_row(c(
  kpi_card("calendar-event", "Peak Month", trend_res$peak_month_count, paste0(format(trend_res$peak_count_val, big.mark = ","), " orders"), "blue"),
  kpi_card("cart-check", "Completed Orders", format(trend_res$completed_orders_analyzed, big.mark = ","), paste(trend_res$date_range, collapse = " to "), "green"),
  kpi_card("cash-stack", "Total Payment", paste0("R$ ", format(round(trend_res$total_payment_value_analyzed, 0), big.mark = ",")), "Analyzed completed orders", "navy"),
  kpi_card("arrow-up-right", "Largest Increase", trend_res$largest_order_increase_month, sprintf("%.1f%% MoM", trend_res$largest_order_increase_pct), "orange")
)))
```

<div class="dash-panel chart-panel">

<div class="dash-panel">
<div class="panel-header"><span class="panel-icon"><i class="bi bi-calendar3"></i></span> Key Months</div>
<div class="panel-body">

```{r trend-key-table, echo=FALSE}
key_months <- trend_res$core_trends[
  trend_res$core_trends$purchase_month %in% c(
    trend_res$peak_month_count,
    trend_res$largest_order_increase_month,
    trend_res$largest_order_decrease_month
  ),
  c("purchase_month", "completed_order_count", "total_payment_value", "order_count_mom_pct")
]
knitr::kable(
  key_months,
  col.names = c("Month", "Completed Orders", "Payment (R$)", "Orders MoM %"),
  digits = 2,
  format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

</div>
</div>

<p class="muted-note">Note: 2016-09 was a partial first month, 2016-11 is absent from the series, and 2016-12 contains only one completed order. These months are excluded from headline comparisons.</p>

<p class="muted-note">The available period is not sufficient to prove recurring seasonality.</p>

)]
knitr::kable(
  trend_table,
  col.names = c("Month", "Completed Orders", "Total Payment (R$)", "Avg Payment (R$)", "Order MoM %", "Payment MoM %"),

<div class="ops-section-header">
<div class="ops-icon"><i class="bi bi-person-exclamation"></i></div>
<h2>B. Seller Prioritization</h2>
</div>

<div class="question-card">
<div class="card-title">Business Question</div>
Which sellers should an operations manager review first based on delivery performance and operational exposure?
</div>

```{r seller-kpis, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
top_score <- seller_res$ranked_sellers$priority_score[1]
cat(kpi_row(c(
  kpi_card("people", "Sellers Analyzed", format(seller_res$total_sellers_analyzed, big.mark = ","), "All sellers in dataset", "blue"),
  kpi_card("person-check", "Eligible Sellers", format(seller_res$eligible_sellers, big.mark = ","), "&ge; 20 records and &ge; 20 valid deliveries", "green"),
  kpi_card("award", "Top Priority Score", sprintf("%.3f", top_score), "Highest ranked seller", "orange"),
  kpi_card("person-x", "Excluded Sellers", format(seller_res$excluded_sellers, big.mark = ","), "Below eligibility rule", "red")
)))
```

<div class="two-col-grid">

<div class="dash-panel chart-panel">
<div class="panel-header"><span class="panel-icon"><i class="bi bi-bar-chart"></i></span> Top 10 Priority Scores</div>

```{r seller-table, echo=FALSE}
seller_top <- head(seller_res$ranked_sellers, 10)
seller_top$seller_id <- short_id(seller_top$seller_id, 8)
knitr::kable(
  seller_top[, c("rank", "seller_id", "valid_delivery_count", "late_delivery_rate", "priority_score")],
  col.names = c("Rank", "Seller ID", "Valid Deliveries", "Late Rate", "Priority Score"),
  digits = 3,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

<p class="muted-note">Full ranking: output/seller/seller_priority_ranking.csv</p>

</div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="insight-card">
<div class="card-title">Practical Interpretation</div>
Top-ranked sellers combine elevated late-delivery rates with enough delivered volume to affect many customers. Priority scores weight late-delivery rate and valid delivery volume.
</div>

<p class="muted-note">Delivery outcomes are shared at the order level for multi-seller orders.</p>

</div>

<div class="ops-section-header">
<div class="ops-icon"><i class="bi bi-shield-check"></i></div>
<h2>C. Data Quality Summary</h2>
</div>

<div class="question-card">
<div class="card-title">Business Question</div>
Are missing values, duplicate keys, inconsistent dates, or payment mismatches affecting analysis reliability?
</div>

```{r audit-kpis, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(kpi_row(c(
  kpi_card("clipboard-data", "Programmatic Checks", format(nrow(issues), big.mark = ","), "Automated audit rules", "blue"),
  kpi_card("calendar-x", "Delivered Missing Dates", format(get_count("delivered_without_actual_delivery_date"), big.mark = ","), "Delivered orders without delivery date", "red"),
  kpi_card("exclamation-triangle", "Canceled With Dates", format(get_count("canceled_or_unavailable_with_actual_delivery_date"), big.mark = ","), "Canceled/unavailable with delivery date", "orange"),
  kpi_card("copy", "Duplicate Processed Keys", "0", "Order and seller-order keys", "green")
)))
```

<div class="dash-panel dash-panel-compact">
<div class="panel-header"><span class="panel-icon"><i class="bi bi-list-check"></i></span> Priority Issues</div>
<div class="panel-body">

```{r audit-compact, echo=FALSE}
priority_issues <- issues[
  issues$issue_count > 0 &
    issues$severity %in% c("High", "Warning") &
    !issues$issue_name %in% c(
      "order_level_rows", "seller_order_rows",
      "duplicate_order_id_processed", "duplicate_seller_order_processed"
    ),
]
priority_df <- data.frame(
  Issue = vapply(priority_issues$issue_name, issue_label, character(1)),
  Count = format(priority_issues$issue_count, big.mark = ","),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(priority_df, align = c("l", "r"), row.names = FALSE)
```

</div>
</div>
